name: Bluesky PDS
description: Host a federated Bluesky Personal Data Server (PDS) and manage accounts on your own domain. This deployment builds and runs the official TypeScript PDS directly in the LXC without Docker or an in-container reverse proxy.

notes.text: Create a Cloudflare Tunnel Published Application route for your PDS hostname. Set the service to HTTP and point it to http://<LXC-IP>:3000. The PDS must be reachable from the machine running cloudflared.

Do not put Cloudflare Access authentication in front of the PDS. Ensure WebSockets are enabled. No Caddy, in-container TLS certificate, or public inbound ports are needed when using Cloudflare Tunnel.

For accounts using the PDS-managed subdomain handles, configure the DNS and hostname routing required for those handles. Custom-domain handles such as krtko.me use an _atproto TXT record pointing to the account DID.
This is a source-built, community-maintained native deployment; it is not the upstream Docker installer and needs testing before production use.
